description: This file contains the implementation of chunk parsing functionality for the Lighttpd web server, including initialization, resetting, parsing chunks, and extracting data between chunk markers.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_init(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,liChunkQueue * cq)
methods.description: Initializes the chunk parser context with a chunk queue and resets its internal state.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_reset(liChunkParserCtx * ctx)
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the chunk parser context to prepare for new parsing activities.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunk_parser_prepare(liChunkParserCtx * ctx)
methods.description: Prepares the parser by ensuring the current chunk element is set, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: liHandlerResult li_chunk_parser_next(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,char ** p,char ** pe,GError ** err)
methods.description: Advances parsing to the next chunk, reads data, and updates buffer pointers.

methods.name: void li_chunk_parser_done(liChunkParserCtx * ctx,goffset len)
methods.description: Updates the parser's internal counters after processing a chunk of data.

methods.name: gboolean li_chunk_extract_to(liChunkParserMark from,liChunkParserMark to,GString * dest,GError ** err)
methods.description: Extracts data between two chunk markers into a GString, handling multiple chunks.

methods.name: GString * li_chunk_extract(liChunkParserMark from,liChunkParserMark to,GError ** err)
methods.description: Creates a new string with data extracted between two chunk markers.

ctags.name: li_chunk_extract_to
ctags.pattern: /^gboolean li_chunk_extract_to(liChunkParserMark from, liChunkParserMark to, GString *dest, GError/
